描述_EN: ‘birth of a nation’ (a suite of 10 drypoint prints) is a critique of contemporary south african society. the title, ‘birth of a nation’ is a reference to the 1915 silent film, directed by d.w. but equally the title refers to south africa’s own political history, founded on, and in the apartheid era, structured around racial discrimination. diane victor (born 1964, south africa) is a renowned printmaker. reflecting the tone of the novels, the film has been described as “a nightmare of interracial brutality, rape and castigation”, and has obvious parallels in south africa. griffiths, ‘the birth of a nation’. the bull now represents africa in the form of a rhinoceros, and it is the victim of violence not its perpetrator. based on two historical novels, the clansman, an historical romance of the ku klux klan (1905) and the leopard’s spots: a romance of the white man’s burden (1902), the film recounts the history of the civil war and reconstruction through the eyes and experiences of southern whites who vehemently opposed the political and social progress made by newly freed african americans after the civil war. europa has become a chinese girl soldier, representing china’s recent role in africa, exploiting the region’s land and natural resources. it also refers to the country’s efforts to redefine its values and identity in the wake of nelson’s mandela’s release from prison, his election as president and the shift to black majority government. the artist turns this myth on its head. amongst the issues addressed are environmentalism, political corruption, violent crime, and sexual and racial violence. here, once again, the artist starts with a myth of rape, the story of zeus transforming himself into a bull, to abduct and rape europa. in these prints victor takes a series of stories from classical myth and recontextualises them to create her own satirical version of a south african national narrative. embedded in this narrative is a poignant yet savage commentary on the state of contemporary south african society, and the struggles and abuses which afflict the post-apartheid era. the rhino here has been shot, a reminder that rhinos are hunted illegally for their horns, which are used in traditional chinese medicine.
描述_ZN: 《一个国家的诞生》（一套10幅干点版画）是对当代南非社会的批评。 标题 "一个国家的诞生 "是指1915年的默片，由D.W.导演。 但同样地，标题指的是南非自己的政治历史，建立在种族隔离时代，围绕着种族歧视结构。 迪安-维克多（1964年生于南非）是一位著名的版画家。 反映了小说的基调，这部电影被描述为 "种族间的残暴、强奸和惩罚的噩梦"，并与南非有明显的相似之处。 格里菲斯，"一个国家的诞生"。 公牛现在以犀牛的形式代表非洲，它是暴力的受害者而不是暴力的实施者。 基于两部历史小说，即《族人，三K党的历史浪漫》（1905）和《豹斑：白人负担的浪漫》（1902），影片通过南方白人的眼睛和经历叙述了内战和重建的历史，他们激烈地反对内战后新解放的非洲裔美国人取得的政治和社会进步。 欧洲已经变成了一个中国女兵，代表了中国最近在非洲的角色，开发该地区的土地和自然资源。 它也是指在纳尔逊-曼德拉出狱、当选总统和转向黑人多数政府之后，该国重新定义其价值观和身份的努力。 艺术家把这个神话翻了个底朝天。 在所涉及的问题中，有环境主义、政治腐败、暴力犯罪以及性暴力和种族暴力。 在这里，艺术家再次从一个强奸的神话开始，宙斯把自己变成一头公牛的故事，绑架并强奸了欧罗巴。 在这些版画中，Victor从古典神话中抽取了一系列的故事，并将其重新编排，创造了她自己的南非国家叙事的讽刺版本。 在这一叙事中包含了对当代南非社会状况以及折磨后种族隔离时代的斗争和虐待的凄美而野蛮的评论。 这里的犀牛已经被射杀，提醒人们犀牛是为了它们的角而被非法猎杀的，这些角被用于中国的传统医学。
